meta.description: Core thematic registry for the Shadow Protocol universe

themes.name: Perception vs. Reality
themes.description: The line between what is real and what is manufactured is the central battleground of the series.

themes.name: Hidden Systems of Power
themes.description: Invisible networks control visible outcomes. The true enemy is never fully visible.

themes.name: Identity Collapse
themes.description: Protagonists whose sense of self unravels as they uncover the truth.

themes.name: Surveillance State
themes.description: Omnipresent observation as both a tool of control and a source of paranoia.

themes.name: Moral Ambiguity
themes.description: No pure heroes or villains — only people making choices in impossible circumstances.

themes.name: The System Always Survives
themes.description: Even when a battle is won, the larger machine continues to operate.
